answer: In this canyon-based agent economy each identity must lock a refundable timber bond of fixed size S in a shared escrow. The bond returns only after twenty consecutive epochs with no detected equivocation. An attacker creating N sybil identities must supply N times S in timber up front; any pair of those identities signing conflicting messages triggers full slash of every related bond into the yarrow reward pool. Honest agents pay nothing net while the attacker’s cost scales linearly with the number of fakes and is permanently lost on detection.
